name: Critical Effects (BC): Explosive - Leg
description: Black Crusade, Table 7-14 (p. 251). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: Knocked back 1 metre. Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or knocked Prone.
Knocked Prone. Half Move movement Actions only for [[1d5]] rounds.
Flung [[1d5]] metres away. It costs a Full Action to regain his feet, and Movement is halved (rounding up) for [[1d10]] rounds.
1 permanent Agility Damage. Difficult (-10) Toughness Test or suffer [[1d5]] levels of Fatigue.
[[1d10]] levels of Fatigue. Leg broken until repaired. Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or permanently lose the foot.
Leg lost. Immediate Challenging (+0) Toughness Test or die from shock. On a success: Stunned for [[1d10]] rounds, [[1d10]] levels of Fatigue and Blood Loss.
The target dies. Anyone within 2 metres takes [[1d10+2]] Impact Damage.
As result 9. In addition, carried ammunition explodes for [[1d10+5]] Impact Damage to anyone within [[1d10]] metres, and any carried grenades or missiles detonate on his person.
